question:
Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank meaningfully.

The ______ on the wall was beautifully painted.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"picture"** refers to a visual representation created using painting, drawing, photography, or other artistic methods. (चित्र)

 
 
• **Example:** She hung a beautiful picture of the sunset on the living room wall.
 
 
 
• The word "picture" is correctly spelt and widely used in English to describe images or representations. (चित्र)
 
 
• **Example:** The picture on the wall was painted by a famous artist.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct word to meaningfully complete the sentence is **"picture"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1 - "pictur"** (अस्पष्ट शब्द): This is an incorrect spelling of the word "picture".

 
 
• **Example:** This spelling does not exist as a valid word in English.
 
 
 
• **Option 3 - "picter"** (अस्पष्ट शब्द): This is another incorrect spelling and does not exist as a meaningful word.
 
 
• **Example:** "Picter" is not a valid English word.
 
 
 
• **Option 4 - "pickchure"** (अस्पष्ट शब्द): This is an incorrect spelling and does not exist as a valid word.
